title: Future's Album Debuts at No. 1; Stones, 'Heated Rivalry' Bow in Top 10
desc: Future's 'The Real Me' became his 12th No. 1 album. The Rolling Stones and the 'Heated Rivalry" soundtrack also debuted in the Billboard chart's top 10.

title: Argentina star punches Spain captain Rodri to spark brawl after World Cup final
desc: Argentina defender Nahuel Molina sparked a brawl immediately after the full-time whistle in the World Cup final by punching Spain midfielder Gavi.

title: Torres fires Spain past Argentina in extra time to win World Cup, denying Messi a 2nd title
desc:
Ferran Torres' first goal of this year's World Cup was the goal of his life, and it put Spain back atop the soccer world.
Denying Lionel Messi a second straight title, Torres came off the bench and scored in the 106th minute and Spain ended Argentina's reign with a 1-0 win on Sunday.

title: When, where, and how Spain won the World Cup final against Argentina
desc: Spain are world champions for the second time after Ferran Torres scored the winner against Argentina in extra time.

title: Dort To Hawks, Risacher To Mavericks In Three-Team Trade
desc: The Thunder are trading Lu Dort to the Hawks in a three-team deal that will send Zaccharie Risacher to Dallas.

title: circular roof opening brings sunlight into casa óculo by OHLAB in palma
desc: casa óculo, designed by ohlab, is a single-family residence located in a residential neighborhood on the outskirts of palma.

title: Imperious Hegarty named The Sunday Game Hurler of Year
desc: The Sunday Game have chosen Gearóid Hegarty as their Hurler of the Year with dominant All-Ireland champions Limerick taking up no less than 10 positions on the show's Team of the Year.

title: Super sub Torres fires Spain to World Cup glory
desc: Super sub Ferran Torres fired Spain to their second men's World Cup triumph as what may be Lionel Messi's last dance ended in 10-man Argentina falling to a meek 1-0 extra-time defeat.

title: Controversies Surrounding the Handling of Febrie Adriansyah’s Corruption Case
desc: The Attorney General's Office has not provided a clear explanation as to why Don Ritto was detained while Febrie was not.

title: Former Port Adelaide coach Ken Hinkley to be announced as Tasmania Devils inaugural coach
desc: The former Port Adelaide coach will be formally unveiled as the inaugural coach of the Tasmania Devils this morning. It completes a year long hunt for a senior coach for the AFL's newest club.
